derived_from.note: Recompute from stored walls only. No provider calls. results.json and freeze.json byte-unchanged.

final_latency_s.definition: per-segment final arrival minus own finalize (final_wall - finalize_wall), seconds

legacy_field_mapping: results.json drain_waits_s is collection elapsed after the whole stream ended, not provider latency. Future script field renamed collection_elapsed_s; per-segment arrival latency added as final_latency_s.

amendments.sessions_methodology: 9 pre-opened per-segment provider sessions (1/2/3/3 across arms), paid 9 matching the frozen 9-session budget. Single-session production behavior untested; no assertion about the ordinary production route end-to-end.
amendments.secondary_split: The F0/H 3262700 split falls inside the later B/A/C overlap region. It is an additional split there, not part of the turn recovery; its consequence is unresolved, neither neutral nor known no-harm. F0 same.
amendments.dup_scope: No-duplicated-words holds for the scored A/C phrases only. Tail overlap region unscored.
amendments.queue: Observed max depth 48 over finite 235-chunk input; 128 was a stall threshold, no hard bound enforced.
amendments.script_repairs: run.py records final_latency_s and collection_elapsed_s, closes sessions in finally with 10 s bound, keeps bounded timeouts.

script_verified: py_compile ok, import side-effect free, zero comment lines, synthetic timestamp check passes.
